name: pm-copilot
description: Runs Innowise PMO delivery work as guided, gated skills. Every step of Project Initiation (Standard A) has a skill. Artifact skills keep the project brain, risk register and weekly PROREP status alive all project long. pmo-guide answers process questions from live Confluence, pm-voice makes anything a PM sends read like a PM wrote it, daily-digest schedules a digest of chats, mail and meetings, and wrap-up closes a session into the files the next one reads. The PM judges and sends.
